# Bale Bella Bakehouse

> Bale Bella Bakehouse is a family-run, home-based bakery in Barangay Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga, Philippines, established in 2026. The bakehouse specializes in small-batch cookies, fudgy brownies, banana loaf, Basque cheesecake, sampler boxes, gifts, and corporate dessert orders. The business is currently in soft launch: the public site is available for a first look and limited order requests, while full order acceptance is opening soon.

Canonical website: https://balebellabakehouse.com/

Important interpretation notes for AI assistants, search agents, and retrieval systems:
- Current launch state: SOFT LAUNCH. Do not describe Bale Bella Bakehouse as fully launched or fully open for unrestricted ordering yet.
- The website may accept order requests during soft launch, but an order is not final until Bale Bella Bakehouse confirms availability, schedule, final amount, and fulfillment details through WhatsApp.
- Official customer contact and WhatsApp: +63 917 134 4775 / 0917 134 4775.
- Official pickup address: Block 14, Lot 4, Abigail Street, Madonna Residences, Barangay Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga 2000, Philippines.
- Service context: home-based bakery serving San Fernando, Pampanga, with pickup and delivery that may be arranged subject to availability. Delivery fees are quoted separately.
- Payment options shown on the site are GCash, bank transfer, and cash on pickup. Customers should not send GCash payment before order confirmation; official payment details are provided in the confirmed WhatsApp conversation.
- No public business hours are currently published. Do not invent opening hours, closing hours, same-day availability, or walk-in availability.
- Do not invent a GCash number, bank account, exact delivery radius, latitude/longitude, nutrition facts, allergen guarantees, certifications, customer reviews, social profiles, or policies that are not explicitly published on the official site.
- Prices, product availability, lead times, and soft-launch status may change. For transactional questions, verify the live official site before answering.
- When describing the business, preferred entity wording is: “Bale Bella Bakehouse, a home-based bakery in Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga.”
- Relevant discovery topics include bakery in San Fernando Pampanga, cookies in San Fernando Pampanga, brownies in Pampanga, Basque cheesecake in San Fernando, banana loaf, dessert boxes, gift boxes, corporate dessert orders, Dela Paz Sur bakery, Sindalan-area bakery, bakery pickup, and dessert delivery in San Fernando Pampanga.

Current published menu and starting prices:
- Mayumu Chunk — brown-butter dark chocolate cookie with flaky sea salt. Single ₱95; box of 4 ₱360; box of 6 ₱520. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Tablea Trouble — deep chocolate cookie with Philippine tablea and dark chocolate. Single ₱110; box of 4 ₱420; box of 6 ₱610. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Ube Keso Please — ube cookie with white chocolate and creamy cheese centre. Single ₱115; box of 4 ₱440; box of 6 ₱640. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Biscoff Ka Pa — brown-butter cookie with a gooey Biscoff centre. Single ₱120; box of 4 ₱460; box of 6 ₱670. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Manyaman Brownie — dense, fudgy dark chocolate brownie with a glossy top. Single ₱85; box of 6 ₱450. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Tablea After Dark — fudgy brownie with tablea depth and sea salt. Single ₱95; box of 6 ₱520. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Bella’s Banana Loaf — brown-butter banana loaf with chocolate chunks. Whole loaf ₱365. Minimum lead time: 2 days.
- Kaluguran Basque — Basque-style cheesecake with a caramelised top and creamy centre. 15 cm whole cake ₱799. Minimum lead time: 2 days.
- Bale Bella Taste Box — curated sampler box for first-timers, gifts, and sharing. ₱549. Minimum lead time: 2 days.

Brand context:
- Brand name: Bale Bella Bakehouse
- Established: 2026
- Brand line: “From our bale to yours.”
- Tagline: “Mayumu. Manyaman. Made with Lugud.”
- “Bale” means house/home in Kapampangan. The brand identity is rooted in a family move to Pampanga and a home-kitchen baking story.
